searchText: I'm trying to use the spec in another project - any ideas on this mypy error? ``` src/ethereum_test/common.py:5: error: Skipping analyzing 'ethereum.base_types': found module but no type hints or library stubs ``` The package is probably not configured to export type hints. Can't remember the PEP number but some quick searching should find it relatively easily. it's weird because i use pyright in my editor and that has been able to give me type info on the `ethereum` module PEP 561 seems to imply we need a `py.typed` file to denote the package is typed okay that appears to fix it, ty
